scripts.build: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs');function c(s,d){if(!fs.existsSync(d))fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync(s)){const p=require('path').join(s,f),t=require('path').join(d,f);fs.statSync(p).isDirectory()?c(p,t):fs.copyFileSync(p,t)}}c('public','dist/public');"
